words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 他们在市中心买了一套新房子。(Tāmen zài shìzhōngxīn mǎi le yí tào xīn fángzi.) — They bought a new apartment downtown.
我想在公司附近租一间公寓。(Wǒ xiǎng zài gōngsī fùjìn zū yì jiān gōngyù.) — I want to rent an apartment near the company.
每个月五号必须交房租。(Měi gè yuè wǔ hào bìxū jiāo fángzū.) — Rent must be paid on the 5th of each month.
厨房里有很多新鲜蔬菜。(Chúfáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō xīnxiān shūcài.) — There are lots of fresh vegetables in the kitchen.
请问，卫生间在哪里？(Qǐngwèn, wèishēngjiān zài nǎlǐ?) — Excuse me, where is the restroom?
客人正在客厅里喝茶聊天。(Kèrén zhèngzài kètīng lǐ hē chá liáotiān.) — The guests are drinking tea and chatting in the living room.
我的卧室朝南，采光很好。(Wǒ de wòshì cháo nán, cǎiguāng hěn hǎo.) — My bedroom faces south, so it gets great natural light.
阳台上种满了漂亮的花草。(Yángtái shang zhòng mǎn le piàoliang de huācǎo.) — The balcony is filled with beautiful flowers and plants.
出门前别忘了带门钥匙。(Chūmén qián bié wàng le dài mén yàoshi.) — Don't forget to take the door key before going out.
你锁好大门了吗？(Nǐ suǒ hǎo dàmén le ma?) — Did you lock the front door?
离开房间请随手关灯。(Líkāi fángjiān qǐng suíshǒu guān dēng.) — Please turn off the light when leaving the room.
天气太热了，把空调打开吧。(Tiānqì tài rè le, bǎ kōngtiáo dǎkāi ba.) — It's too hot, let's turn on the air conditioner.
冰箱里有冰水和新鲜水果。(Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu bīngshuǐ hé xīnxiān shuǐguǒ.) — There is ice water and fresh fruit in the fridge.
脏衣服已经放进洗衣机了。(Zāng yīfu yǐjīng fàng jìn xǐyījī le.) — The dirty clothes have been put in the washing machine.
洗澡前先开一下热水器。(Xǐzǎo qián xiān kāi yíxià rèshuǐqì.) — Turn on the water heater before taking a shower.
下楼的时候顺便把垃圾扔了。(Xiàlóu de shíhou shùnbiàn bǎ lājī rēng le.) — Take out the trash when you go downstairs.
书桌旁边有一个小垃圾桶。(Shūzhuō pángbiān yǒu yí gè xiǎo lājītǒng.) — There is a small trash bin next to the desk.
我们每个周末都打扫房间。(Wǒmen měi gè zhōumò dōu dǎsǎo fángjiān.) — We clean the apartment every weekend.
我下个月搬家到新小区。(Wǒ xià gè yuè bānjiā dào xīn xiǎoqū.) — I'm moving to a new residential community next month.
隔壁邻居为人非常热情友好。(Gébì línjū wéirén fēicháng rèqíng yǒuhǎo.) — The next-door neighbor is very warm and friendly.
我们坐电梯上八楼。(Wǒmen zuò diàntī shàng bā lóu.) — Let's take the elevator up to the 8th floor.
走楼梯对身体锻炼很有帮助。(Zǒu lóutī duì shēntǐ duànliàn hěn yǒu bāngzhù.) — Taking the stairs is great exercise for the body.
浴室的水龙头坏了，正在漏水。(Yùshì de shuǐlóngtóu huài le, zhèngzài lòushuǐ.) — The bathroom faucet is broken and leaking.
请师傅今天下午来修空调。(Qǐng shīfu jīntiān xiàwǔ lái xiū kōngtiáo.) — Please have the technician come fix the air conditioner this afternoon.
这个小区环境非常安静舒适。(Zhè ge xiǎoqū huánjìng fēicháng ānjìng shūshì.) — This neighborhood environment is very quiet and comfortable.
